name: parsinegar.documents
description: Parsinegar document management: Markdown documents in nested folders over pey.storage.service

provides.name: parsinegar.documents.service
provides.description: Multi-document management for Markdown records with automatic timestamps.

methods.name: listDocuments
methods.description: Lists all documents ordered by most recently updated first.

methods.name: openDocument
methods.description: Reads one document by id, or null when it does not exist.

methods.name: saveDocument
methods.description: Creates or overwrites a document, stamps updatedAt, publishes documents:changed.

params.name: input
params.type: { id?: string, title?: string, content?: string, folderId?: string | null }

methods.name: createDocument
methods.description: Creates a new empty document with the given title, suffixing until unique. Lands in the given folder, or the root.

params.name: folderId
params.type: string | null (optional, defaults to the root)

methods.name: renameDocument
methods.description: Renames a document by id, or null when it does not exist. Rejects duplicate or empty titles, publishes documents:changed.

methods.name: deleteDocument
methods.description: Deletes a document by id (no-op when absent), publishes documents:changed.

methods.name: setReadOnly
methods.description: Locks or unlocks a document for reading by id (no-op null when absent), publishes documents:changed.

methods.name: listFolders
methods.description: Lists all folders flat (the caller nests them by parentId).

methods.name: createFolder
methods.description: Creates a folder under the given parent (or the root), suffixing the name until unique among siblings.

params.name: parentId
params.type: string | null (optional, defaults to the root)

methods.name: renameFolder
methods.description: Renames a folder by id (no-op null when absent), publishes folders:changed.

methods.name: deleteFolder
methods.description: Deletes a folder with all descendant folders and contained documents (each publishing documents:changed), publishes folders:changed. No-op when absent.

methods.name: moveDocument
methods.description: Moves a document into a folder (or back to the root with null). No-op null when either side is absent.

events.name: documents:changed
events.description: Published after a document is created, saved, renamed, moved, deleted or lock-changed.

events.name: folders:changed
events.description: Published after a folder is created, renamed or deleted.
